// A healthy script: the analyzer should stay silent.
use shop

db.orders.find({ customerId: 42, createdAt: { $gt: ISODate("2026-01-01") } }, { customerId: 1, total: 1 }).sort({ total: -1 }).limit(20)

db.orders.aggregate([
  { $match: { status: "paid", total: { $gte: 10, $lte: 500 } } },
  { $lookup: { from: "customers", localField: "customerId", foreignField: "_id", as: "customer" } },
  { $unwind: "$customer" },
  { $group: { _id: "$customer.region", revenue: { $sum: "$total" }, orders: { $count: {} } } },
  { $sort: { revenue: -1 } },
  { $limit: 5 },
  { $project: { _id: 0, region: "$_id", revenue: 1, orders: 1 } },
  { $merge: { into: "regionRevenue", whenMatched: "replace" } }
])

db.orders.updateMany(
  { status: "new" },
  { $set: { status: "queued" }, $currentDate: { updatedAt: true }, $push: { history: { $each: ["queued"], $slice: -10 } } }
)

db.orders.updateOne({ _id: 1 }, [{ $set: { total: { $add: ["$subtotal", "$tax"] } } }, { $unset: "scratch" }])
db.orders.deleteMany({ status: "cancelled", createdAt: { $lt: ISODate("2020-01-01") } })
